```{=html}
<style>
.w082-sort { max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 0.92rem; }
.w082-sort .w082-buckets { display: flex; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; align-items: stretch; }
.w082-sort .w082-bucket {
  flex: 1 1 0; min-height: 170px; padding: 6px 8px;
  border: 2px dashed var(--bs-border-color, #999); border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); cursor: pointer;
}
.w082-sort .w082-title { text-align: center; font-weight: 700; color: #d81e2e; margin-bottom: 6px; }
.w082-sort .w082-bucket.w082-armed { border-color: #d81e2e; }
.w082-sort .w082-pool {
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px;
  min-height: 44px; padding: 8px; border-radius: 6px;
  border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #ccc); margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}
.w082-sort .w082-chip {
  display: block; margin: 0; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 8px;
  cursor: grab; user-select: none; font-weight: 600; text-align: center;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff);
}
.w082-sort .w082-bucket .w082-chip { margin: 6px 0; }
.w082-sort .w082-chip.w082-picked { outline: 3px solid #d81e2e; outline-offset: 2px; }
.w082-sort .w082-chip.w082-right { border: 2px solid #2e7d32; }
.w082-sort .w082-chip.w082-wrong { border: 2px solid #d81e2e; }
.w082-sort .w082-controls { display: flex; gap: 8px; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.w082-sort button {
  padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); cursor: pointer;
}
.w082-sort .w082-msg { font-weight: 700; min-height: 1.4em; text-align: center; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.w082-sort .w082-msg.ok { color: #2e7d32; }
.w082-sort .w082-msg.bad { color: #d81e2e; }
.w082-sort .w082-note { font-size: 0.78rem; font-style: italic; opacity: 0.7; }
.w082-sort .w082-expl {
  font-size: 0.85rem; opacity: 0.85; border-left: 3px solid #2e7d32;
  padding: 6px 10px; margin-top: 8px;
}
</style>
<div class="iw w082-sort" id="w082">
  <div class="w082-buckets">
    <div class="w082-bucket" data-cat="sast">
      <div class="w082-title">SAST — static testing</div>
      <div class="w082-slot"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="w082-bucket" data-cat="dast">
      <div class="w082-title">DAST — dynamic testing</div>
      <div class="w082-slot"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="w082-pool" aria-label="statements to sort"></div>
  <div class="w082-controls">
    <button type="button" class="w082-check iw-check">Check</button>
    <button type="button" class="w082-reset iw-reset">Reset</button>
    <button type="button" class="w082-solution iw-solution">Show solution</button>
    <span class="w082-note">(no fun if you click it right away)</span>
  </div>
  <div class="w082-msg iw-msg" role="status"></div>
  <div class="w082-expl iw-expl" hidden>SAST examines the source code before deployment, so it runs during continuous integration; DAST probes the running application from outside, so it runs during continuous delivery against the staged application. One sees the code but not its behaviour, the other the behaviour but not the code — see <a href="#sec-08-secure-development-lifecycle">the section on the secure development lifecycle</a>.</div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  const root = document.getElementById('w082');
  const pool = root.querySelector('.w082-pool');
  const buckets = [...root.querySelectorAll('.w082-bucket')];
  const msg = root.querySelector('.w082-msg');
  const ITEMS = [
    ['Runs during continuous delivery, against the staged application', 'dast'],
    ['Examines the source code before deployment', 'sast'],
    ['Sees the behaviour but not the code', 'dast'],
    ['Scans for hard-coded credentials, keys and tokens before they enter the repository', 'sast'],
    ['Runs during continuous integration, so that vulnerable code does not merge', 'sast'],
    ['Probes from outside, emulating real attacks', 'dast']
  ];
  let picked = null;
  function chipByKey(key) { return root.querySelector('.w082-chip[data-key="' + key + '"]'); }
  function unpick() {
    if (picked) picked.classList.remove('w082-picked');
    picked = null;
    buckets.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('w082-armed'));
  }
  function clearMarks() {
    root.querySelectorAll('.w082-chip').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('w082-right', 'w082-wrong'));
    msg.textContent = ''; msg.className = 'w082-msg iw-msg';
  }
  function place(bucket, chip) { bucket.querySelector('.w082-slot').appendChild(chip); clearMarks(); }
  function makeChip(text, cat, key) {
    const c = document.createElement('span');
    c.className = 'w082-chip';
    c.textContent = text;
    c.dataset.cat = cat; c.dataset.key = key;
    c.draggable = true;
    c.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (c.parentElement !== pool) { pool.appendChild(c); unpick(); clearMarks(); return; }
      if (picked === c) { unpick(); return; }
      unpick(); picked = c; c.classList.add('w082-picked');
      buckets.forEach(b => b.classList.add('w082-armed'));
    });
    c.addEventListener('dragstart', e => e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', key));
    return c;
  }
  buckets.forEach(b => {
    b.addEventListener('click', () => { if (picked) { place(b, picked); unpick(); } });
    b.addEventListener('dragover', e => e.preventDefault());
    b.addEventListener('drop', e => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const chip = chipByKey(e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain'));
      if (chip) { place(b, chip); unpick(); }
    });
  });
  pool.addEventListener('dragover', e => e.preventDefault());
  pool.addEventListener('drop', e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const chip = chipByKey(e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain'));
    if (chip) { pool.appendChild(chip); clearMarks(); }
  });
  root.querySelector('.w082-check').addEventListener('click', () => {
    root.querySelectorAll('.w082-chip').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('w082-right', 'w082-wrong'));
    let right = 0, wrong = 0;
    buckets.forEach(b => b.querySelectorAll('.w082-chip').forEach(c => {
      if (c.dataset.cat === b.dataset.cat) { c.classList.add('w082-right'); right++; }
      else { c.classList.add('w082-wrong'); wrong++; }
    }));
    const left = pool.querySelectorAll('.w082-chip').length;
    msg.className = 'w082-msg iw-msg';
    if (wrong === 0 && left === 0) {
      msg.textContent = '✓ All correct — static and dynamic testing are cleanly separated.';
      msg.classList.add('ok');
    } else if (wrong === 0) {
      msg.textContent = 'Keep going — ' + left + ' statement(s) still to sort.';
    } else {
      msg.textContent = '✗ Not yet — ' + wrong + ' statement(s) sit in the wrong box (marked red).';
      msg.classList.add('bad');
    }
  });
  root.querySelector('.w082-solution').addEventListener('click', () => {
    unpick();
    root.querySelectorAll('.w082-chip').forEach(c => {
      const bucket = buckets.find(b => b.dataset.cat === c.dataset.cat);
      if (bucket) place(bucket, c);
    });
    root.querySelectorAll('.w082-chip').forEach(c => c.classList.add('w082-right'));
    root.querySelector('.w082-expl').hidden = false;
    msg.textContent = 'Solution shown — reset to try it yourself.';
    msg.className = 'w082-msg iw-msg ok';
  });
  root.querySelector('.w082-reset').addEventListener('click', () => {
    root.querySelector('.w082-expl').hidden = true;
    root.querySelectorAll('.w082-chip').forEach(c => pool.appendChild(c));
    unpick(); clearMarks();
  });
  ITEMS.forEach((it, i) => pool.appendChild(makeChip(it[0], it[1], 'k' + i)));
})();
</script>
```
